purpose: Test whether Qwen3.5-0.8B behavior-family subspaces form lineage-connected, noise-valid context-by-checkpoint loops on three separately analyzed base-to-adapter grids.
claim_boundary: This analysis may establish or falsify family-resolved identity geometry on the four frozen engineering model states. The adapter checkpoints are an engineering checkpoint axis only. The analysis cannot establish VPD efficacy, causal edit value, capability preservation, compactification, recursive improvement, or RSI.

primary_object.rank_selection: largest prefix rank passing the strict bootstrap-versus-label-permutation margin at every node in a pair grid

instrument_calibration.kind: matched_random_named_family positive construction plus label-permutation null
instrument_calibration.failure_effect: Cap all certificates at engineering_evidence with negative_control_not_passed.

graph.edges: adjacent context shards within each state plus same-shard cross-state edges

holonomy.construction_validation_agreement: determinant component must agree and maximum-angle difference must not exceed max(1 degree, matched noise upper 95)
holonomy.nontrivial_signal: Validation maximum canonical angle must exceed the matched flat/noise 95th percentile; aggregate support requires at least three sites across two families.
holonomy.det_negative: categorical orientation reversal; suppress canonical angles

corotation.comparison: within-family distance versus matched cross-family distance at equal supported rank
corotation.gate: 95% lower confidence bound of cross-family median distance minus within-family median distance is strictly positive
corotation.failure_effect: Render independent family globes; do not invalidate identity attestation.

analysis_order: validate all state-index and chunk hashes
analyze each registered state pair independently
apply the real-label versus permutation rank gate
build G_tau and compute beta_1 before loop measurement
compare admitted loop holonomy to the frozen prompt-resample noise null
emit per-pair and composite receipts without consuming behavioral outcomes
